SUPPLEMENTARY_attribution.purpose: Honest attribution the registered H556 baseline confounds: min-node-degree is a HARMFUL control (drags baseline AUC 0.681->0.638), inflating +forman delta-AUC. These isolate forman vs hop-ALONE.

forman_over_hop_alone.reading: delta-AUC 0.003 << 0.03 retirement floor -> forman REDUNDANT WITH HOP on AUC; LR detects a whisker of independent likelihood (p~0.0015) but no practical AUC gain

min_deg_over_hop_alone.reading: min-node-degree HURTS (negative delta-AUC): the registered baseline is weakened by it

partial_spearman_forman_fail.reading: orthogonal to CERT (r=-0.343,p<1e-4) but VANISHES given hop (r=-0.04,p=0.66): forman sees the same failure class as seed-hop-distance, not one hop is blind to

SUPPLEMENTARY_attribution.bottom_line: min-Forman (degree-bottleneck) IS a real fail/pass signal (H555 bar met) but it is seed-hop-distance in another dress (Spearman 0.91). The registered H556 'earns-seat' (delta-AUC 0.065) is a confound from a broken min-degree control; over hop-alone delta-AUC=0.003 -> REDUNDANT. min-Forman is NOT degenerate with min-node-degree (corr 0.19) - that registered framing is incorrect; it is degenerate with HOP.
